title: Mica Millar Impresses With Her New Single "Trouble"
htmlContent:
Mica Millar, a British singer, has the incredible new single "Trouble," packed with great melodies and above-average arrangements and seasoned with Mica's beautiful voice. 

Delivering a soul of beautiful melodies and arrangements, complemented by her wonderful and powerful voice, the singer shows all her qualities in a song that involves you in every second of the audition for its beauty and emotion.

The new song is already available on the leading streaming platforms and has a beautiful official video, which can be watched at the link below.

Stream "Trouble" on Spotify
